chunks: And from him, from al-Mīthamī, from Abān, from Ismāʿīl al-Juʿfī, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:

"Do you know why one dhirāʿ and two dhirāʿs were instituted?" He said: I said, "Why?" He said: "Because of the place of the obligatory prayer, so that time is not taken from the time of this one and entered into the time of that one."

key_terms.الذِّرَاعَانِ: Two cubits; a prescribed measure associated with prayer timing.
key_terms.الذِّرَاعُ: A cubit; a legal measure used here in determining prayer timing.
key_terms.الْفَرِيضَةِ: The obligatory prayer whose designated time must be preserved.
key_terms.وَقْتِ: The appointed time of a prayer.

ai.seo_question: Why were one dhirāʿ and two dhirāʿs designated in relation to the times of salat?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the legal wisdom behind assigning the measures of one dhirāʿ and two dhirāʿs in relation to prayer times. The purpose is to preserve the proper time of the obligatory salat so that the time allotted to one prayer is not encroached upon by another.
